snippet:
The Escort Redline 360c was supposedly a radar detector that Escort could never build. What Escort has done here is combine their best radar detector platform with all of the sophisticated bells and whistles of the very popular selling Escort Max 360c Mk II. The directional Redline 360c is the successor to the previous non-directional Redline and Redline EX radar detectors.

#### ✅ Pros [...] Secure the Escort MAX 360c MkII at RadarBusters to utilize active discount codes and skip sales tax  
Compare marketplace pricing for the Escort MAX 360c MkII on Amazon  
Check Stock at Escort

Escort’s new MAX 360c MkII radar detector replaces the outgoing Escort MAX 360c. It gets an updated M13 platform, the same that can be found in the Escort MAXcam 360c, which ups its sensitivity by 3dB, equating to about a 40% increase in detection range.

#### ✅ Pros [...] The Escort MAX 4 is the replacement to Escort’s outgoing MAX 3. The MAX 4 sports a number of significant improvements including dual LNAs, improved signal processing power and filtering. The MAX 4 appears to be Escort’s answer to the popular Uniden R4 and in our real-world testing, it has proven to be as sensitive to radar as the R4 but with better filtering.

#### ✅ Pros

 Best value-priced detector from Escort
 Exceptional BSM filtering
 Smooth and accurate signal ramp-up

title: Best Radar Detectors of 2026: Expert Reviews & Buyer's Guide
snippet:
The Escort Redline 360c is a top pick for a long range and easy to use radar detector, especially for your everyday driver. It’s a long range detector with arrows, excellent false alert filtering, and some of the best hands-free automation. It ticks nearly every box you could want in terms of features and capabilities. [...] ### Uniden R8w

Uniden R8wIf you’re looking for a long range radar detector that excels against all types of police radar, has GPS built-in, decent false alert filtering, arrows, a large display, photo radar detection, and a variety of third-party app options purchase the Uniden R8w.

 ### Escort Redline 360c

Escort Redline 360cFor the everyday driver wanting a high end yet simpler experience, purchase the Escort Redline 360c.

 ### Valentine 1 Gen2 [...] Long range detection is in the same ballpark as the Escort Redline 360c and the Uniden R8w. It’s also very responsive against instant on radar on Ka like the R8w, but it performs more like the Redline 360c on K band. It also struggles against some lower powered radar guns too like the Kustom Falcon HR and Raptor RP-1.
